technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot to build the custom module as an uber-jar for easy deployment.
Leverage Spring's WebSocket support for full-duplex communication channels.
Use Gradle as the build tool with npm-cache for dependency caching in CI.
Configure distributed JVM tests and adjust parallelism settings in CI builds.
Integrate PMD and Sonar for static code analysis and violation notifications.
Set up Windows-based CI infrastructure using Bamboo for integration testing.
Use xd/lib as the shared location for common dependent jars across modules.
assumptions: Developers are already familiar with Spring Framework and Gradle.
Access to required CI tools like Bamboo, Artifactory, and Windows environments is available.
Documentation for building custom modules already exists or can be referenced from Spring guides.
HDFS is accessible and configured for hosting uber-jars.
Existing CI infrastructure supports enabling distributed JVM tests and parallelism.
Sonar and PMD configurations are already in place or can be set up with minimal effort.
Windows environment for CI is accessible and PowerShell is available.
xd/lib folder is accessible and used as the shared dependency location.

activities.activity_name: Documentation Review and Custom Module Setup
activities.activity_description: Review Spring documentation and set up the custom module project structure using Spring Boot to build an uber-jar.

activities.activity_name: Uber-JAR Build and HDFS Deployment Configuration
activities.activity_description: Configure the build process to generate an uber-jar and set up deployment to HDFS for container access.
Implement a native WebSocket sink using Spring's WebSocket support to enable full-duplex communication.

activities.activity_name: CI Options Research and npm-cache Integration
activities.activity_description: Research CI options and integrate npm-cache to improve build stability by caching dependencies.
Enable distributed JVM tests, switch to command-based Gradle tasks, disable embedded Hadoop tests, and enable maxParallelForks.

activities.activity_name: PMD/Sonar Violation Investigation and Notification Setup
activities.activity_description: Investigate WARN logs, fix PMD/Sonar violations, and configure notifications to committers.
Set up Windows-based CI infrastructure using Bamboo, configure PowerShell access, and set up required services for integration tests.
Configure xd/lib as the shared location for common dependent jars and handle version conflicts via bundling.
